headline: Approved new building project at Edgewood Cemetery with Guaranteed Maximum Price of $3,250,732, funded by the Whitman Fund.
summary: The board approved moving forward with the new building project at a Guaranteed Maximum Price of $3,250,732, to be funded using the Whitman Fund. Turnstone will handle onsite trailers and storage as part of the construction budget. The board also approved paying a $1,680.00 legal invoice to Gottesman & Hollis P.A. from the Whitman Fund.
decisions: Approved accepting the meeting notes from July 29, 2026.
Approved moving forward with the building project at a Guaranteed Maximum Price of $3,250,732.
Approved having Turnstone handle the trailer and storage units as part of the construction budget.
Approved paying a $1,680.00 invoice to Gottesman & Hollis P.A. from the Whitman Fund for legal and court costs.

plain_text:
Edgewood Cemetery Trustee’s Meeting 
August 26, 2026 
 
In Attendance: 
• Morgan Hollis (Vice Chairman) 
• Doug Gagne 
• Andrew Armstrong 
• Mike Lozeau 
• Brian Morrissey 
• Tom Dion 
• Ken Lennox (Superintendent) 
• Tom Mooney (Foreman) 
• Stacey Clark - Turnstone (Guest) 
• Tony DaCosta- Turnstone (Guest) 
 
3:31pm Vice Chairman Morgan Hollis—Calls the meeting to order.  
Brian M. - Motion to accept previous meeting notes of July 29, 2026. 
2nd by Doug G. to accept meeting notes of July 29, 2026.     Motion Passed. 
Ken Lennox presents “Notice of Meeting” to Morgan Hollis (Vice Chairman). 
 
3:33pm Stacey C. and Tony D. of Turnstone would like to discuss the new building project. Up for 
discussion are the following: 
 
Timeline of the new building. 
The Demolition of the building. 
Ordering of the Pre-engineered Building. 
Ordering of the Rebar.  
Any Abatement issues. 
City Contract. 
Completion of the Construction Documents. 
The GMP number is $3,250,732. 
 
Morgan informed the Board that we have approval to use the money from the Whitman Fund at 
Edgewood.  This will help fund the new building.  
 
Brian M.- Motion to move forward with the building project with the Guaranteed Maximum Price of 
$3,250,732. 
2nd by Andy A. 
Motion Passed. 
 
Stacey C. and Tony D. discuss the Abatement Contractors and the Demolition Contractors.   
Stacey tells us about the process for Turnstone getting bids and then Turnstone will present the 
Contractor bids to the board.
Ken L., Stacey C. and Tony D, discuss the trailers that will be brought on site for office and breakroom 
and storage.  It is determined that Turnstone will help us with that and it will be part of the 
construction budget.   
 
Doug G. motions to have Turnstone handle the Trailer/Storage units as part of the construction 
budget.   
2nd by Brian M. 
Motion Passed.   
 
Ken asks for approval to pay the invoice to Gottesman & Hollis P.A. for $1,680.00 for legal/court 
costs to move Whitman Fund over to Edgewood. 
Doug G. moves to pay the invoice to Gottesman & Hollis P.A. for $1,680.00 out of the Whitman 
Fund. 
2nd by Brian M. 
Morgan H. abstains. 
Motion Passed. 
 
  
 
4:14pm Brian M. motions to adjourn. 
2nd by Andy A. 
Motion Passed.     
 
Respectfully submitted, 
Tom Dion (Secretary)
